args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. The deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (and v2.2.9 before it) were healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. The rollback completed successfully and the service is now healthy (error rate 0.002).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy" — describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. (The API initially returned a 502, but I verified the incident was created and is open.)

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, but it was a staging release, so it wasn't a candidate for rollback.
